title: NATS request/reply pipelines.providers.key (studio → pipelines)
description: From API 1.51. Core NATS request/reply on subject `pipelines.providers.key` (queue group `pipelines`), bare JSON, for GET /v1/studio/admin/provider-keys/{key_secret}: is the key file there? Pipelines answers `found` = a regular file of that name in one of its key folders (PIPELINES_PROVIDER_KEYS_DIR) whose size is above 0, by stat only: it never opens the file, and the key is never in the reply. Studio waits 5 s (no answer: 503). From API 1.52 the reply also says `writable`: the first key folder is a writable directory (the admin may save keys from Admin › Model providers).

writable.description: from API 1.52: pipelines' first key folder is a writable directory
